# Expiration Reminder

> > Expiration Reminder is a compliance automation platform that tracks document expirations, credentials, and renewals across multiple industries with AI-powered scanning and automated alerts.

Expiration Reminder provides enterprise-grade document and credential lifecycle management for organizations managing certifications, contracts, insurance, permits, licenses, and equipment. The platform combines automated expiration tracking, AI-powered document scanning, multi-location management, and compliance reporting to help businesses stay audit-ready and avoid costly lapses.

## Key Topics

- Expiration Tracking
- Compliance Management
- Document Management
- Automated Reminders
- Credential Tracking
- Certification Management
- Contract Management
- Permit Tracking
- AI DocScan
- Equipment Maintenance
- Fleet Management
- HIPAA
- SOC 2
- GDPR
- Automated Renewals
